palettes.comment: Drawn to the full 300 m, thinning out evenly from 45 m (distanceFalloff 0.15), 2026-10-15: hard render distances (90 m, copies to 30/60 m) gave extreme pop-in in GreenKeeper. Green is the bulk, straw/brown the accent (Marcus 2026-10-15): in every tall rough mix the green items have distance copies (the carpet item to 15 and 30 m, the other green items to 30 m; each copy thins from 15% of its distance, so about 3x at 3 m and 1x at 30 m, no line) and their tints were moved 6 deg toward green and 15% darker, toward the ground mesh as rendered (hue 67, value 0.3), for a better blend and less pop-in. The accents have no copies and keep their tints. 2026-10-16 (Marcus): the VSP grass 30 % thicker within 30 m of play on Omberg, which has far fewer trees than Vreta and GPU budget for it: every texture item's sampleDistance divided by sqrt(1.3) (x0.877; the mask values cap at maxDensity 1, so the density has to come from the spacing), and the tall-grass near rule in vegetation-rules.json thins it back to the old density beyond about 45 m. The far mix (rough_tall/far) is unchanged. 2026-10-17 (Marcus: far too dark against the ortho/OPCD ground, pop-in): the two green items (and the far mix's same two) x1.75 in linear light, measured on hole 1's deep rough (Unity 719/578): ground/grass luminance 1.82 -> 1.02 top-down from 10 m, 1.62 -> 1.04 from his 30 m oblique view. The straw and seed-head accents keep their tints. Then (Marcus: still too much dark grass close up) randomDarkening 0.2 -> 0.3 on the same items: VSP darkens each instance by saturate(random + randomDarkening), so 0.2 left a fifth of the green near black; 0.3 keeps a dark mix, close-up p10 luminance +27 %, still 1.04x the ground from his 30 m view (0.4 read 1.13x there and 1.55x top-down). The distance copies had kept the old tints (the live adjust reached base items only, fixed in GolfMapVegLive).

palettes.comment: Drawn to the full 300 m, thinning out evenly from 45 m on (distanceFalloff 0.15, 2026-10-15): a hard render distance at 45/90 m popped and left the water bare.

VSP only (Stix wispy retired 2026-10-14). Copies to 30 and 60 m (denser near the camera) over the base drawn to 300 m; every layer thins out evenly from 15% of its own distance (distanceFalloff 0.15) so no layer ends in a line. Density noise off (even spread), spacing x sqrt(2).

Grass and moss in the cracks and on the ledges of the shore rock (pipeline/rock_shore_zones.py, a mix layer on the slab). 2026-10-16: the tall rough's textures and tints, low, at 1.75x the tall rough's density (its spacing after the 2026-10-16 x0.877, then / sqrt(1.75)); copies on the green items only. No moss card or detail prefab in the Omberg project (Forest_detail_moss is Arborist-only): the moss is the green base texture 14 cm tall, tinted darker.

Heather and lingonberry on the ledges and the thin soil beside the shore rock (2026-10-16), the woodland heath's plants and looks. Their names hold 'heather' / 'lingonberry', so the prefabItemsInVsp rule leaves them to the course's VSP (NatureManufacture's grass-shader plants are white from the sun's side in Arborist: docs/gspro/arborist.md).

Low scrub hugging the shore rock and along Vättern (2026-10-16): hazel the bulk, grey willow, maple bush and birch sapling, young and dwarf pines; a little lower than the shrub thicket (wind). The shrub palette's tints and materials. Arborist draws them (prefabItems arborist).

Dry and green grass under and between the shore scrub (2026-10-16, a mix layer): the tall rough's and the fresh rough's textures and tints at 1.75x the tall rough's density (its spacing after the 2026-10-16 x0.877, then / sqrt(1.75)); copies on the green items only.
